svg.title: Wildkin seeded continent diagnostic overview
svg.desc: Development-only vector overview sampled from world seed 1327115068, edition 1. It shows the exact irregular continent outline, three current regional terrain grammars, shallow coastal shelves, and five known anchors.
svg.text: Unrevealed geography shown for development — this is not the player’s atlas.

Surface color and relief come from the current pure terrain sampler; markers show development witnesses, not travel promises.
